preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call setShares() function
Contract must have swapAndLiquifyEnabled = true and trade must be enabled
Contract must have accumulated fee tokens in its balance (minimumTokensBeforeSwap or more)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setShares() with marketingShareNew = 0 and burnShareNew = 0 to set totalDistributionShares to 0. Then trigger swapAndLiquify() by making a transfer that accumulates fees and exceeds minimumTokensBeforeSwap. This will cause division by zero at line 540 (tAmount.mul(burnShare).div(totalDistributionShares)), potentially causing the transaction to revert or behave unpredictably.
